read.thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 5% to ₹4,245 cr (12.8% ex one-off); RE capacity added 539 MW in quarter, 765 MW H1, against FY27 guide of 2,500-2,700 MW, with H1 capex ~₹10,000 cr and net debt up to ₹62,681 cr.

utilisation.quote: Mundra Plant continues to run under Section 11, reported availability of 89%
